### Knowing about God is Not Enough
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/knowing-about-god-is-not-enough-girlfriends-in-god-november-10-2014.html
Passage: John 5:39-40
Points:
- Accumulating biblical knowledge without a personal bond with Jesus misses the fundamental point of Scripture.
- Having accurate doctrine is not the same as having a genuine, living relationship with God.
- The Bible is meant to foster communication with the Lord rather than become a substitute for Him.
- Intellectual facts must move from the head to the heart to produce true worship and transformation.

### Reading Without Seeing: How Not to Study the Bible
Author: Joshua Bremerman
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/reading-without-seeing
Passage: John 5:39-40
Points:
- Diligent Bible reading can fail to honor God if students miss Jesus Christ Himself.
- Studying Scripture rightly should naturally ignite earnest prayer, heartfelt worship, and dependence on God.
- Grasping biblical facts must serve the greater goal of beholding Christ and enjoying Him.
- Believers depend on the Holy Spirit to move beyond mere head knowledge into inward heart transformation.
